tool_input.command: for f in package.json index.html pigment.app.json README.md vite.config.ts src/main.tsx src/App.tsx src/components/*.tsx src/pages/*.tsx src/styles/base.css tests/smoke.spec.ts; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; ls; cat pigment-snap.mjs 2>/dev/null | head -50

Get-ChildItem -Force | Select Name; foreach ($f in @('package.json','index.html','pigment.app.json','README.md','vite.config.ts','src/main.tsx','src/App.tsx','src/components/BarChart.tsx','src/components/Layout.tsx','src/components/ProjectsTable.tsx','src/components/StatusPill.tsx','src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx','src/pages/OverviewPage.tsx','src/pages/ProjectDetailPage.tsx','src/pages/ProjectsPage.tsx','src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx','src/pages/TeamPage.tsx','src/styles/base.css','tests/smoke.spec.ts')) { "=== $f"; Get-Content -Raw $f }
